root_cause_status: 007 proves an online success was rejected solely because the observer saw two health GETs. There is no product contract requiring exactly one background-inclusive GET.
source_trace: BridgesView.onPing clears result, sets disabled, awaits pingHealth, then shows OK iff result is non-null.
pingHealth performs healthCheck using real side-panel apiGet GET /health; no bridge/proxy owns this request.
REST transport assembles bearer and organization before fetch; pre-dispatch session handling can therefore delay or prevent any observed /health request.
Health GET can coexist with app-start/after-sign-in health requests. Exact-one-request assertion may reject concurrency, but 006 lacks evidence to confirm this hypothesis.
Network observer is scoped to the owned side-panel CDP session and filters pathname /health.

BackendSwitcher displays its resolved backend.url in the title of the span beside the manual health button. Runner reads that UI destination in memory and observes only same-session Fetch GET requests to its exact /health URL for proof.
